result.document_summary: A page from the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 2, Government) covering contractor debarment procedures (Div. 8) and City real property leases, sales, exchanges and broker fees (Div. 9), despite being addressed at a URL for the algorithmic rent-pricing ban.
result.notes: This part of the document contains only municipal contracting debarment provisions and rules on the City's own leases and sales of City-owned real property, plus broker commissions on those City transactions. None of this falls into the six in-scope residential rental categories, and the text of the algorithmic rent-pricing prohibition that the URL suggests (Division 11) does not appear in this part, so no rules are extracted.
